summary: The proof establishes the stated uniform actual third-depth-moment bound with the given positive absolute constant. The pre-absorption product conversion in 8db3ba8c8761ea6c applies with interval cardinalities R+1, retained rank m, and b_ge3=m; 4735bc2a8a6d5fa9 supplies the capacity surplus in exactly the same normalization. The coordinate flips and height reversal are invertible affine maps with the displayed score identities, so original root probabilities and all closed-halfspace depths are preserved. The partition growth comparison satisfies precisely the hypotheses of the abstract height-band assertion proved in ac4157e446425a3d. The product domination uses the correct fourth power of its coefficient. The low-budget argument covers singleton and binary slices, while the high-budget argument covers K'=0 separately and all real height tilts, including zero. The final square completion and polynomial absorption give exactly the second coefficient of kappa. No counterexample or gap occurs at L=0, L<h, m=1, zero transverse scores, or tilt ties.
